=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2600-2605 (merge/terminal sites 2810-2831, 2933-2955) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In auto mode, the new `state_unavailable` branch in `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient` calls `continue` without setting `RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED="true"` or a deferred outcome. After three unreadable reads the helper returns 1 with `RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP="exhausted"`, so the merge and terminal sites take their `else` branch and set `RB_MERGE_STATUS="merge_failed"` (lines 2831 / 2954) instead of `mergeability_pending`.
  WHY: During a GitHub 5xx or rate-limit window the run ends as `merge_failed`. That status keeps the paging "Needs merge investigation" alert (review_autofix.yml 5977-5997) and stall recovery does not re-fire the judge, which contradicts Goal 4 ("leaves the PR for the next review run"). `test_unreadable_pr_state_sends_no_auto_merge_call` does not assert the final status, so the test misses it. Severity is MAJOR for every reviewer that stated one; gemini gave no severity.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2796-2813, 2919-2935 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the merge and terminal paths, the pre-merge `_pr_merge_state_check` runs before `review_head_gate_post_status` (a network POST, lines 2811/2934), and `gh pr merge --auto` follows without another state read.
  WHY: If the PR is closed while the status POST is in flight, the merge request still goes out on the earlier open-state result, which can merge a closed PR. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna said MAJOR and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said NIT (a documented pipeline contract at lines 2808-2809, a one-call window); gemini stated no severity. The highest is used here. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly considered this and did not report it.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2769-2784 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume`, the only `_pr_merge_state_check ... pre_merge` (2775-2779) now runs before `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (2780). That gate's compare and lease read/write calls sit between the state read and `gh_retry gh pr merge ... --auto --match-head-commit` (2784).
  WHY: A PR that closes during the compare or lease calls (a window that widens under gh_retry backoff) takes the lease and still gets `gh pr merge --auto`, and GitHub accepts that for a closed, unmerged PR (the #10049/#5800 failure mode). Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said NIT (glm calls it a documented tradeoff), openai_gpt-6-luna said MAJOR; gemini stated no severity. The highest is used here.
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:368-376 (job env 39-45) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The new unlinked-run match (`((.pull_requests // []) | length) == 0 and .head_sha == $head_sha and ... (.created_at < $closed_at)`) is not gated on `merged`. The caller triggers on `types: [closed]`, which includes merges, so the review run that performed the merge matches and is cancelled during its post-merge work.
  WHY: On every merged PR whose review run is still in the deterministic-skip step or the judge's post-merge labelling and notification, that run is cancelled and its remaining steps are skipped. #10049 only needs closed, unmerged PRs. Suggested fix: add `PR_MERGED` to the env and gate the clause with `$merged != "true"`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_merge_retry_transient, lines 2600-2605 (the new `if [ "${_rb_retry_mode}" = "auto" ] && [ -z "${_rb_retry_state}" ]; then ... outcome=state_unavailable"; continue; fi`), together with the `merge` site at lines 2810-2831 and the `terminal` site that sets `RB_MERGE_STATUS="merge_failed"` at line 2954. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new branch skips the `--auto` request, the guarded direct retry and `rb_judge_sync_merge_guard`. With `RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED="false"` (line 2810) and three unreadable reads, the helper falls through to `RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP="exhausted"; return 1` (line 2633), the deferred arm at line 2818 is skipped, and the `else` arm sets `RB_MERGE_STATUS="merge_failed"` (line 2831). The status used to be `mergeability_pending`.
  WHY: During a 5xx or rate-limit window, `merge_failed` is not on the non-paging list in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (lines 5977-5997), so it pages a human. This contradicts Goal 4, and the test does not assert the final status. Suggested fix: set `RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED="true"` and `RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP="deferred"` before the `continue`.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_final_ci_merge_resume, lines 2769-2784. The last run moved the `_pr_merge_state_check ... pre_merge` call (2775-2779) ahead of `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (2780). The merge call is at 2784. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The only state read now precedes the freshness gate, whose compare and lease calls go through `gh_retry` with backoff, so it is no longer the last call before `gh pr merge --auto --match-head-commit`. The old order already met Goal 3, because the guard releases the lease on `closed`.
  WHY: A PR closed during the compare or lease calls reaches `gh pr merge --auto`, and GitHub merges a closed, unmerged PR (#10049). Suggested fix: move the guard back to right after `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge`.
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:lines 368-376, the unlinked-run match (`((.pull_requests // []) | length) == 0 and .head_sha == $head_sha and ... (.created_at < $closed_at)`), and the job env at lines 39-45 (no `merged` input). | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The caller triggers on `types: [closed]`, which includes merges. The review run that merged the PR is unlinked, at the head SHA and created before `closed_at`, so it is cancelled mid-post-merge work (in the incident, labels landed 16-32s after the merge).
  WHY: Merged PRs get their review runs cancelled and the remaining steps skipped. #10049 only needs closed, unmerged PRs. Suggested fix: add `PR_MERGED` to the env and pass `--arg merged`, then gate the clause with `and ($merged != "true")`.
- Excluded by the reviewer (not reported): the pre-merge check running before `review_head_gate_post_status` (a documented contract, lines 2808-2809); draft not re-read in the retry loop or `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard` (judged unreachable); the merge-train "read immediately before the merge" gap (a duplicate of the finding above).
- HARDENING: tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py test_unreadable_pr_state_sends_no_auto_merge_call. Assert `judge_merge_status=mergeability_pending`, not `merge_failed`, after three unreadable reads (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
